title: Northstar - paired stakeholder map
source: Fictional Northstar stakeholder exercise after M-D001
scope: Migration planning and rehearsal boundary; placements are qualitative working assessments
state: support-agent representation and several action commitments remain proposed
decision_boundary: Use the paired maps to improve engagement and voice while preserving actual business, operations, technical, supplier and funding authority.

dimensions.power_basis: Ability to shape, regulate, approve, supply or block the migration within a stated domain.
dimensions.interest_basis: Demonstrated or credibly evidenced engagement with migration outcomes.
dimensions.impact_basis: Material consequence to workload, service operation, accountability or business outcome.
dimensions.placement_warning: Categories are qualitative hypotheses; no measured coordinates or within-quadrant ranking are supplied.
dimensions.authority_warning: Participation, supplier influence and technical feasibility do not automatically create business or operational acceptance authority.

stakeholders.name: Noel
stakeholders.evidence: Sponsor authority is supplied; high interest and accountability impact remain working assessments.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on choices, exceptions and consequence tradeoffs.
stakeholders.authority: Funding and baseline authority; no inferred business or operations acceptance.
stakeholders.migration_action: Provide decision-ready options with evidence and affected-population consequences.
stakeholders.trigger: Material scope, funding, schedule or residual-obligation choice.

stakeholders.name: Saira
stakeholders.evidence: Business acceptance role and high workflow relevance are supplied.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely and co-develop population and correctness evidence.
stakeholders.authority: Business acceptance; participation by agents does not transfer this authority.
stakeholders.migration_action: Validate agent representation and review relationship evidence and exceptions.
stakeholders.trigger: Population, relationship rule or acceptance evidence changes.

stakeholders.name: Rosa
stakeholders.evidence: Operations role and ongoing service impact are supplied; detailed evidence needs remain to confirm.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on recoverability, coverage and handover evidence.
stakeholders.authority: Operations acceptance; refusal of unproven restore is an evidence signal, not a personality label.
stakeholders.migration_target: Remain manage closely / Q2 with evidence-based confidence
stakeholders.migration_action: Elicit restore criteria and include Rosa in applicable demonstration review.
stakeholders.trigger: Restore evidence, support boundary or handover plan changes.

stakeholders.name: Chen
stakeholders.evidence: Technical role is supplied; formal acceptance boundary remains separate.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on executable plan, mapping and retest.
stakeholders.authority: Technical execution influence; no inferred business or operations acceptance.
stakeholders.migration_action: Clarify mapping handoff, correction scope and feasible retest sequence.
stakeholders.trigger: Mapping, defect population or environment changes.

stakeholders.name: Beck
stakeholders.evidence: Supplier role is supplied; internal acceptance authority and direct operating impact cannot be inferred.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on interface, obligations and escalation while independently verifying evidence.
stakeholders.authority: Supplier commitment authority to verify; no internal business or operations acceptance.
stakeholders.migration_target: Keep satisfied or manage closely as Q4 gatekeeper based on obligation evidence
stakeholders.migration_action: Confirm interface, obligation, commitment and escalation path.
stakeholders.trigger: Supplier commitment, personnel or mapping obligation changes.
stakeholders.note: Supplier confidence is not independent readiness proof.

stakeholders.name: Support agents
stakeholders.scope: Search, archive, attachment and escalation workflows
stakeholders.evidence: High daily-work impact is a working hypothesis; no named representative or elicited interest is supplied.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Seek direct feedback rather than assume passive notification.
stakeholders.authority: No formal approval authority assigned; participation does not replace Saira or Rosa.
stakeholders.migration_target: Keep informed with deliberate Q1 voice elevation
stakeholders.migration_action: Recruit representative workflow trials and record explicit disposition of material issues.
stakeholders.trigger: Representative identified, rehearsal evidence changes or scope is phased.
stakeholders.note: A demo invitation alone does not create high power.

events.label: M-D001 approved
events.state: Migration boundary and sponsor context established.

events.label: Stakeholder review cutoff
events.state: Support-agent representation and restore evidence needs remain open.

events.label: Rehearsal evidence
events.state: Observed relationship failure increases the need for direct workflow evidence.

presentation.headline: Frontline impact is different from approval power
presentation.lede: Compare engagement strategy with operational consequence so agents enter the evidence loop without displacing actual acceptors.
presentation.decision: Validate agent representation, capture workflow evidence and keep Saira's and Rosa's acceptance boundaries explicit.

analysis.method: Run Power x Interest and Impact x Power independently, then compare the qualitative placements.
analysis.comparison_rule: Q1 stakeholders outside manage-closely require an explicit voice-elevation decision; unknowns remain outside the grids.
analysis.voice_rule: Representative workflow trials elevate evidence contribution without silently granting business or operations acceptance power.
analysis.authority_boundary: Sponsor, business, operations, technical and supplier power are domain-specific and not interchangeable.
analysis.revisit_rule: Reassess after phasing, vendor personnel changes, workflow evidence, scope changes or actual delegated authority.
